headline: Kadıköy
tagline: The soul of the Asian side — art, food, and the best street energy in Istanbul.

items.name: Fazıl Bey'in Türk Kahvesi
items.description: Istanbul's most iconic Turkish coffee shop. Tiny, no-frills, and perfect. The dark roast is mandatory.
items.tip: Queue outside is normal — it moves fast. Get the dark roast (koyu).

items.name: Kronotrop Coffee Bar
items.description: Specialty coffee pioneers in Istanbul. The Kadıköy branch is the best spot to work from in the morning.

items.name: Moda Sahne Café
items.description: Seafront café with stunning Bosphorus views. Come for sunset coffee.
items.tip: Arrive 30 min before sunset to get a window seat.

items.name: Çiya Sofrası
items.description: A legendary Anatolian kitchen serving rare regional dishes from across Turkey. A must for any food lover.
items.tip: Arrive at noon when the daily specials are freshest. Always changing menu.

items.name: Borsam Taş Fırın
items.description: The best lahmacun in the city. Thin, crispy, loaded with herbs. Queue is worth it.
items.tip: Get there at 12:30 on weekdays — shorter queue, fresher batches.

items.name: Baylan Pastanesi
items.description: A Kadıköy institution since 1923. Their copa (chocolate sundae) is iconic and unchanged for decades.

items.name: Balıkçı Kahraman
items.description: No-frills fish restaurant loved by locals. Fresh catch of the day, excellent meze, very reasonable prices.

items.name: Kadife Sokak (Barlar Sokağı)
items.description: The bar street of Kadıköy. A dense strip of meyhanes, live music venues, and cocktail bars. Start here on any night out.
items.tip: Weekdays are mellower and more local. Weekends get packed after 11pm.

items.name: Karga Bar
items.description: Kadıköy's most beloved alternative bar. Art on the walls, great music, mixed crowd. A classic.

items.name: Arkaoda
items.description: Rooftop bar with an exceptional view of Kadıköy. Live music on weekends. Great for a sundowner.

items.name: Kadıköy Produce Market
items.description: One of the best outdoor markets in Istanbul. Perfect for fresh produce, olives, cheese, and spices. Saturdays are best.
items.tip: Go on Saturday morning. Bring a bag — you will buy more than you plan to.

items.name: Moda Park & Promenade
items.description: A quiet waterfront park with beautiful Bosphorus views, perfect for morning runs or evening walks.

items.name: Yeldeğirmeni Street Art
items.description: The Yeldeğirmeni neighbourhood just behind Kadıköy is covered in incredible street art. Great for a walking tour.

tips: Take the ferry from Eminönü or Beşiktaş — it's scenic and fast.
The market area and Kadife Sokak are best explored on foot. Park outside and walk.
Most restaurants don't take reservations. Arrive early (12pm or 7pm) to avoid queues.
Kadıköy has some of the city's best secondhand bookshops along Söğütlüçeşme Cad.
